name: Ennui
source:
You follow Kai, a raccoon, going through the motions of a boring life, only looking forward to his martial arts classes. During a class, he is hit with the reality that he is to participate in a competition he has no recollection of signing up for. 

Follow Kai as he relearns a skill long forgotten with the help of a newfound friend.

[From [url=https://ikaiii.itch.io/ennui]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你跟随浣熊凯，过着无聊的生活，只盼着他的武术课。在课堂上，他突然意识到自己要参加一场他不记得参加过的比赛。

跟随凯在新朋友的帮助下重新学习一项早已被遗忘的技能。

[来自[url=https://ikaiii.itch.io/ennui]Itch.io[/url]]
